---
title: "Archive"
listing:
  contents: posts
  sort: "date desc"
  # A table rather than cards. The front page is for reading; this page is for
  # finding, so every post is one line and the whole history fits on one screen
  # for a long time.
  type: table
  fields: [date, title, categories, reading-time]
  field-display-names:
    date: "Published"
    title: "Post"
    categories: "Languages"
    reading-time: "Length"
  # The two controls that make this an archive rather than a list. `sort-ui`
  # lets a reader order by date or by title, and `filter-ui` searches every
  # field, so typing a year narrows to that year and typing `polar` finds the
  # post about circles. That covers what a year and month tree would have done,
  # without a heading for every empty month.
  sort-ui: [date, title]
  filter-ui: [date, title, categories]
  # No paging here. Finding something means seeing everything at once.
  page-size: 200
  # One feed for the site is enough; this page would only duplicate it.
  feed: false
page-layout: full
---

Every post, newest first. Sort by either column, or use the filter to narrow the
list. A year works, and so does a language or a word from a title.
